_about: The last good load-rehearsal numbers (scripts/load-trend.mjs warns when a run falls well behind). Update an entry when a change makes the app faster or slower on purpose. ci = GitHub's x86 runner (100 users, 90 s); local = the development laptop with Docker Desktop (100 users, 120 s).

local.measured: rounds 27–32 on the dev laptop with Docker Desktop, 120 s: 42–64 requests a second, page p95 2.0–4.9 s (a busy laptop runs slow)
